one_liner: Copper CRM has a broad REST Developer API using API-key headers, but no free tier: API needs a Professional plan or a 14-day trial, and OAuth app registration requires emailing Copper.
auth_notes: API key is generated in System settings > API Keys and sent with X-PW-AccessToken, X-PW-Application and X-PW-UserEmail headers. OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow exists, but you must contact partners@copper.com to register an app, so it isn't self-serve. Results from developer.copper.co and usecopper.com describe different products and were ignored.
access_notes: No free plan. A 14-day free trial (no credit card) includes API access. Basic plan has no API; Professional ($59-69/seat/mo) and Business include it. Signup is Google-only.
blocker_notes: API needs Professional or higher, or the 14-day trial, which is short for ongoing toolkit testing. Self-serve OAuth is not available because app registration goes through partners@copper.com.

evidence.quote: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0. API Keys are suitable for individual users, while OAuth2.0 is the preferred approach for partner integrations.
